structured_output.world_model:
W5 (contrarian), after E047. The tip is still E036 (5.314 s; seeds 0–2 at 0.7532).

1. Noise floor. Commit 60645dd has now read 0.7532, 0.7525, 0.7497 and 0.7544 on seeds 0–2 across rebuilds and diagnostics, so the build-plus-seeds SD is about 0.2 pp around a population mean of about 0.7525–0.7530. A neutral change clears 0.753 roughly 40% of the time. Both of my last two accuracy misses (E043 and E046) came from bands that were too tight or set too low. Neutral changes should get bands of ±0.3 pp centred on about 0.7527, not shifted down.

2. Freezing with annealing is close to free; changing the objective or the averaging is not. E028, E036 and E046 each annealed a group's LR to 0 and then detached it, and none showed a detectable loss on seeds 0–2. E046 read 0.7540. E025, E030, E032 and E044 changed the loss or the averaging and lost 0.2–0.5 pp. The early freeze in E037 (60%) did lose, so the dose matters: freezing is free only after the stem has seen 32 px and the LR has already decayed.

3. Hidden per-step cost (my unconventional mechanism, now partly confirmed). E046 saved about 10 ms per frozen step, about a third of a 32 px step, beyond what FLOP accounting predicts. A frozen block drops its wgrad, its memory-bound BN/GELU backward, its Muon renorm and Newton-Schulz kernels (bf16, one small kernel per parameter), and the next group's dgrad stops at its input. E043/E047 found 27% of a 32 px step in fused memory-bound kernels and about 2.5% of non-step GPU work per trial. So step time ≈ conv compute + roughly 30% elementwise/optimizer tail. Levers that leave the math bit-identical (batched Newton-Schulz for same-shape filters, a fused copy path) are worth about 1–3% each. Swapping the activation saves less than the bytes suggest, because BN statistics and residual traffic dominate the fused kernels, not erf.

4. Steps versus pixels. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). Adding early steps (E045) bought no more than the epoch dial does. Removing early steps (E040, E041) cost about the same as a uniform trim. The epoch dial runs at about 1.2–1.8 s/pp.

5. Time reproduces to about ±0.02 s. Pixel accounting predicts resolution and step levers well but under-predicts backward truncation by 1.5–2×.

6. Strategy. The best route under the time objective is to stack freezes and buy accuracy back with epochs: group-2 freeze plus a top-up should dominate E036 by about 2%. A pure systems lever that keeps per-seed outcomes intact can still fail the 0.753 gate on rebuild noise alone, so it should be judged on held-out seeds and time, not on seeds 0–2 alone.

Unsure:
- E046's 20-seed delta (not shown to me);
- whether Inductor saves a bool mask for ReLU;
- whether ReLU costs CIFAR-100 accuracy (airbench chose GELU for accuracy; my prior is −0.2 to −0.4 pp);
- how the PCIe judge treats bandwidth-bound levers.

forecasts.reason: E046 (5.079 s) plus about 6 more 32 px steps lands near 5.20 s, right at the 2% bar (5.208 s). The accuracy gain from the top-up (~+0.1 pp) is below rebuild noise, so the 0.03 pp criterion cannot be resolved cleanly.

At most about 135 ms of non-step work is addressable, and realistically about 50–90 ms of it gets removed. Accuracy is the tip's population mean plus rebuild noise, so it clears the gate only about half the time.
The fused kernels are bound by BN and residual bytes, not erf, so the saving is about 1–2%, not the ≥3% the hypothesis needs. ReLU probably costs 0.2–0.3 pp on a short CIFAR-100 run.

cruxes: What was E046's 20-seed held-out delta against a same-build E036 baseline? It decides whether group-2 freeze plus a top-up dominates E036 and whether a group-3 or deeper freeze cascade is worth trying.

In E046's saving, what share went to optimizer work (Muon renorm/Newton-Schulz and foreach copies) versus backward convs? If optimizer work is ≥20% of a step, a batched Newton-Schulz with identical math is the next free ~2–3%.
Is the fused BN/activation kernel time bytes-bound regardless of activation type? This settles whether ReLU, or dropping a BN/activation from the residual path, can buy ≥3%.
